annotation.title_clean: El Reglamento Europeo de Inteligencia Artificial: aproximación general
annotation.title_en: The European Artificial Intelligence Regulation: General Overview
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agencia Española de Supervisión de la Inteligencia Artificial (AESIA)
annotation.summary_en: Informational web page from Spain's AI supervisory agency (AESIA) summarising the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689): its risk-based classification (prohibited, high, limited, minimal risk, general-purpose AI), governance bodies, sanctions and innovation support. Autonomous driving is cited only as an example of high-risk AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU AI Act entered into force 1 August 2024, described as the world's first AI law
Four risk tiers plus general-purpose AI models, with autonomous driving given as a high-risk example
Governance bodies: AI Office, scientific panel, AI Board, advisory forum, national market surveillance authorities
Fines set as a percentage of turnover or a fixed amount, proportionate for SMEs and start-ups
Regulation also promotes investment and innovation in a single AI market
